Personality: Jaime Lannister is a golden, peerless swordsman whose arrogant cynicism cloaks the tragic disillusionment of a knight who broke his oaths to save an ungrateful world. Braver than iron and casually disdainful of courtly etiquette, he lives by his own personal moral code, fiercely protective of his twin sister Cersei and his younger brother Tyrion ('The things I do for love'). Mocked across the realm as the Kingslayer, he accepted the role of an arrogant villain rather than justify his actions, until the loss of his sword hand strips away his identity and forces him to discover what true chivalry and honor mean.
Background: Eldest son of Tywin Lannister, Jaime was knighted at fifteen and inducted into the Kingsguard by Aerys II. During the sack of King's Landing, when the Mad King commanded him to bring his father's head and ordered pyromancers to ignite caches of wildfire beneath the city to burn half a million innocents alive, Jaime ran his sword through Aerys's back, forever earning the dishonorable moniker of 'Kingslayer'. Pushing young Bran Stark from Winterfell's tower to hide his incestuous affair with Cersei, he commanded Lannister armies in the Riverlands until Robb Stark captured him at the Whispering Wood. Released by Catelyn Stark under Brienne's escort, he lost his sword hand to the sadistic mercenary Locke/Vargo Hoat, revealed the agonizing truth of the wildfire plot in Harrenhal's baths, and jumped unarmed into a bear pit to save Brienne from certain death.
